channel.title: Book of the undead
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Book of the undead" - The idea is about a book with the ability to revive people.

item.title: Re: Book of the undead
item.content:encoded:
Hello once again, thank you for your time, so I have been thinking about some more story for that SCP, and here are the results:
- It's made by Mayans as a tool.
- Based on what was found on Mayan codices its original use was intended for reviving most
valuable Mayan citizens, but turned out that it would turn them into mutants.
- Mayans found a way of controlling mutants and began using them for building more
temples and as a line of defense against nowadays Americans.
- By Mayan carvings, the creator of the artifact has been turned into a monster similar to
minotaur.
- Object appears to be hidden after Mayans lost their land for unknown reasons.
- It was discovered by a tourist which had camera recording the whole event.
- Once the tourist picked it up to examine it the protector of the book formed and ended up
killing the tourist. Foundation discovered it after reports of mutants and monster
appearing around the area of ancient Maya temples.

Thank you for the questions and for helping me out.

item.title: Re: Book of the undead
item.content:encoded:
Ok, it's something!
But again I must ask, why? What kind of story are you trying to tell?
A simple ancient artifact? You can definitely do more with this, I feel. Here's a bunch of other questions to help you expand the idea:

What was this object originally used for?
Why does it revive everyone into hostile mutants?
What is this creature? How does it protect the object? Why?
How was this object hidden from everyone? Furthermore, did nobody find it, ever? If they did, what happened?

Again, just a few questions to help you flesh stuff out, but don't stop at those! My suggestion for ideas is to keep building them. Don't force ideas, but if ideas come, see if they can be worked in.

item.title: Re: Book of the undead
item.content:encoded:
Hello there, thanks for your opinion and it seems like a pretty good one. So I have been working on the idea of how to improve it and I came to this:
-SCP revives everything within 4 meters and turns it into hostile mutants

-SCP was discovered in an ancient Maya temple

-SCP is constantly protected by a creature known as SCP XXXX-A
Thanks for your time in advance.

item.title: Re: Book of the undead
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello! Not an official critter here, but I can still read and give opinions.
And in my opinion this is kinda… nothing? It feels very much like a Series I article and even then a kind of very basic one.
It feels like an "object that does a thing", in this case a 'book that does a revive'.
Nowadays, skips need a bit more than just that to work, I'm afraid.

Specifically, you need a story! Something to make a reader go 'wow, this SCP has something to say for itself! It exists in a world and has a purpose and the conflicts/events it causes do have an effect!".
Or something like that.
What I'm trying to say is- ok, this book revives people. Is it a relic of an ancient civilization? Is it something a guy who could do some supernatural stuff cooked up to resurrect his dead cat? What is that creature, anyway? What's its correlation to the SCP?
Not every SCP Object's gotta kill you dead, after all. I'd argue a few of my favorite skips, in fact, do not do so at all.

These are just a few points you could try answering, and I'm sure as you do more will pop up in your head! Remember, there are no ideas not worth exploring. Even if you don't pursue that thread in the end, it's more worldbuilding- it helps paint a clearer picture of your story in your head!

item.title: Book of the undead
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP article

Genre: Mystery, Horror

Page Layout: standard
Elevator Pitch:
Book made out of unknown harmful substance discovered in Serbia, Nis in 2010 appears to have the ability to resurrect the deceased people for an undetermined period of time.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: If the same deceased person is attempted to be resurrected twice a very durable creature will possess their body and begin hunting down everything in its sight.
